name: Can an in-law suite be customized for aging-in-place and mobility needs?
description: Yes, detached suites can be built with single-level layouts, wider doorways, zero-threshold entries, and roll-in showers with safety fixtures.

mainEntity.name: Can an in-law suite be customized for aging-in-place and mobility needs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, building for senior relatives often calls for universal design and accessibility features to ensure safety and comfort. Many homeowners incorporate single-level floor plans, zero-threshold entryways, wider doorways to accommodate mobility aids, and walk-in showers or tub-to-shower conversions with grab bars and slip-resistant tile. Planning these features before framing begins prevents costly interior remodeling down the road and allows older family members to remain fully independent in their own space.
